title: Book Club Board
seo_title: Book Club Charcuterie Board for 6–10: Shopping List & Plan
description: A book club charcuterie board for 6–10: triple-crème brie, aged white cheddar, Manchego, Gorgonzola dolce, prosciutto, speck, pear, figs and truffle honey.
hook: A refined afternoon board, arranged from mild to bold so the cheeses become part of the conversation.
why: The cheeses go in tasting order: mild triple-crème brie, then aged white cheddar, nutty Manchego and finally Gorgonzola dolce. A board that leads people from mild to bold gets talked about, which suits a book club.
Silky prosciutto and lightly smoky speck sit between the cheeses, and each cheese has a partner: truffle honey for the brie, quince paste for the Manchego and pear for the blue.

timeline.what: Take all the cheeses out of the fridge.
Slice the pear and figs; fill the small bowls.
Place the cheeses in tasting order; set out the truffle honey.
Add the prosciutto, speck and fruit.
Pour the wine as members arrive.

faq.q: What do you serve at a book club?
faq.a: A cheese board is ideal: easy to graze while talking. Four cheeses from mild to strong, two cured meats, fruit, honey, nuts and crackers.

faq.q: What order should cheeses go in?
faq.a: Mild to strong: fresh or soft, then semi-firm, then aged, then blue. Taste them in that order too.

faq.q: What wine goes with this board?
faq.a: A dry white like Sauvignon Blanc for the brie and a light red like Pinot Noir for the Manchego and speck.
